text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's been a while since Hishi Akebono scouted me as her trainer. Today, we're spending a little time together.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Yup, yup, these look juuust right! I bet
they're super—Ah, but I
shouldn't pick too
many from the same spot!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Let's run over to the next mountain to
forage some more! Come on,
Trainer!
Hurry, hurry! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A few days earlier...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Hey Trainer, are you free this weekend? I want to make a hot pot sumo wrestlers eat called chanko, and I need ingredients.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I've always wanted to gather ingredients
together with my trainer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
At most, I figured we would go to her
favorite fish and vegetable
stalls, but that
notion was quickly dashed when we
headed into the mountains to collect
mushrooms.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Okay, that should do it. Next stop is the
sea!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Our basket is overflowing with mushrooms
after traversing five whole
mountains. I try
to lift it up, but...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! With all those mushrooms, it's
gonna be real heavy! Just leave
that
basket to me.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Up we go! ☆

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She lifts the basket as if it were nothing
and slips her arms into the backpack
straps. With the basket securely resting
against her back, she walks off with a
smile.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: DRAAAUGH!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Look at the size of this sea bass!
Trainer, can you keep watch over the
cooler?
There's a lot of hungry kitty cats in the
area.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Ah, I spy an even bigger fish! Come here!

text_block_list.name: Local A
text_block_list.text: Uh... Sorry, did that girl just catch a fish with her bare hands?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Yahoo! Look at this huge fish!

text_block_list.name: Local B
text_block_list.text:
Oh come on, you must be seeing thi—huh?
Wait, you're right... But,
like, literally
how?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Catching people's attention everywhere
we go, we continue to gather ingredients.
Seeing our haul and feeling my body
aching, I start to suggest we head back,
when...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: All right, next stop is the butcher!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Yup! There's this butcher I like that
sells
the most scrumptious ground
chicken. We
can't have our hot pot without that!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: It's a tad far from here, but the view on the way is totally worth it! Come on, let's gooo!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I watch her run off,
her imposing silhouette
getting smaller and smaller. We've
probably walked several dozen kilometers
today, yet she shows no signs of fatigue.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After over an hour on the train,
we finally arrive in a deceptively
peaceful small rural
town. If only I knew of the disaster to
come!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Mmm! That country air smells so good!
W-wait, is that a boar?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Oink! Oink!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Awww, it is! What a cute little piggy.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: ...Wait, why is it getting closer?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Stomp, stomp, stomp, stomp!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Eep! Wh-wh-whoa! Trainer, run away!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Terrified, it takes me a few too many
seconds to react. As I turn to
run, I lose my
balance...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And fall into the nearby river, along with
our hard-earned hot pot
ingredients.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Are you okay, Trainer?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Thankfully, I'm not hurt, but all the
mushrooms and fish Hishi
Akebono worked
so hard to get are floating away...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
No, I'm more worried about you than some
silly food. Besides, we can
just buy extra
meat instead! No worries! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: However, when we get to the butcher...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Huh?! They're closed?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And then,
as if to rub salt in our wounds...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: We missed the last bus?!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
It's so early! Did they change the
timetable? I swear there was a
different
one when we got off... I'm sorry, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Let's see... the first bus arrives at six
o'clock in the morning, so that
meeeans...
we have twelve hours?! For real?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hoping to avoid camping out, I contact
the academy and try to find
us
accommodations, but to no avail...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: So we're camping, huh?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After all that work collecting
ingredients, we end up stuck in the
countryside for the
night... Hishi Akebono may be tough, but
she must be pretty shake—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Oh well, these things happen! Ah, look
here! I've got some canned
food and rice,
so why don't I make us some mixed rice? ☆

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, it's not every day that we can go
camping. Might as well enjoy
ourselves. ♪

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Wow! Look at the sky, Trainer! The stars
are so pretty!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her smile doesn't betray a hint of fatigue
or disappointment. There's
even a bit of a
skip in her step as she trots off.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
When I turn my eyes up, though, I realize
she was right—the stars are
especially
beautiful out here.
